bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small clutches up to 4.5" x 6.5" are allowed. Backpacks, purses and diaper bags are not permitted.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
One gallon clear plastic freezer bag
Small clutch up to 4.5" x 6.5", with or without a strap
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions are made for medically necessary items after inspection at the doors. Clutches are also subject to search.

parking.summary: Parking arrangements vary by event. Accessible entry to the garage requires a valid ADA-compliant license plate or hangtag.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has not published specific rideshare guidance on its official venue or guest-information pages.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Chartwells operates concession stands and portable carts throughout the concourse. Major credit cards are accepted at concessions.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The arena has accessible parking, restrooms, concessions, seating, and public entrances. Guests may contact the Houston Athletics Ticket Office for assistance.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Guests receiving player tickets must enter when the ticket is issued and follow the arena’s no-re-entry policy.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: General will call is available in advance at the Houston Athletics Ticket Office and at both arena ticket booths on game day. Game-day windows open 60 minutes before tipoff, and photo ID is required.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: For basketball, gates and game-day ticket windows open 60 minutes before tipoff. Visiting-team will call is at the Holman Street ticket office.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
